about.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
about.about:
Full Stack Software Engineer experienced in designing and developing scalable web applications in C#, .NET Core, Web API, Angular, SQL Server/PostgreSQL and Azure Functions. 
 
 Experienced in building scalable SaaS applications, REST APIs, reusable frontend components & managing CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based solutions. Strong hands-on experience across frontend, backend, database and cloud layers with a focus on performance, reliability and maintainability.

projects.name: Digital Marketing Platform
projects.techstack: Next.js 16, .NET 8 (C#), EF Core, PostgreSQL, JIRA, Azure Repos
projects.desc1: Designed a central server to act as an integration hub for a multi-tenant digital marketing platform, ensuring all third-party API calls were routed, tracked, and controlled centrally for better observability and security while eliminating duplicate applications.
projects.desc2: Implemented a centralized Failed API Call Logging System along with a custom Background-Service (Cron Worker) that periodically retrieves pending failed API requests, reconstructs them using stored metadata, and safely retries them using dependency injection.
projects.highlight: Centralized Failed API Call Logger + Background Cron Worker for Safe Auto-Retries

projects.name: Performance Assessment System
projects.techstack: Angular 18, .NET Minimal API (C#), EF Core, LINQ, PostgreSQL
projects.desc1: Architected and implemented dynamic KRA/KPI scoring algorithms to quantitatively evaluate employee performance and generate objective grading and appraisal outputs in a scalable application architecture with multi-level appraisal workflows used by HR teams.
projects.desc2: Created reusable Angular components to improve UI consistency and development speed, and optimized stored procedures to reduce page load times, significantly improving application responsiveness and scalability.
projects.highlight: Dynamic KRA/KPI Quantitative Scoring Algorithm + Multi-Level Appraisal Workflows

projects.name: Warehouse Management System
projects.techstack: React + TypeScript, .NET Core Minimal API (C#), EF Core, SignalR, Azure Repos, PostgreSQL
projects.desc1: Designed and developed a Warehouse Management System using .NET Core Minimal API (C#) and React + TypeScript, implementing JWT authentication and claim-based authorization to enforce role-specific access.
projects.desc2: Integrated SignalR for real-time inventory update notifications and order status tracking; architected PostgreSQL database schema with optimized entity relationships for high-throughput inventory tracking, order management, and user activity logs.
projects.highlight: Real-Time SignalR Inventory Tracking + Claim-Based JWT Authorization

desc: Architected a Trend Forecasting Module that consolidated 3 separate backend API calls into single unified endpoint with client side metric filtering, significantly reducing server loads & network overhead.

Owned end-to-end delivery of a full-stack Angular 22 SSR platform for a Government Agency client architecting a Strapi v5 headless CMS backend with custom content types, REST API integration, and role-based content access control from initial design to production deployment.

Led the transformation of a legacy monolithic Tire Dealer Management System into a cloud-native, microservices-based architecture using Azure Functions & Azure Blob Storage, enabling modular application development and improved scalability.
Managed CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for development environment testing to streamline delivery and catch integration issues development cycle.

Collaborated with clients and cross-functional teams in Agile sprints, translating requirements into technical solutions, coordinating development activities, and supporting iterative feature delivery.
